description: Sovereign YouTube Podcast Hub & Audio/Video Player Mode

userStories.title: Implement YouTube Podcast Feed Extractor
userStories.description: As a user, I want A1 Swaara to fetch authentic podcast video metadata from YouTube so I see real talk shows and interviews instead of random songs.
acceptanceCriteria: Query YouTube search endpoint using YouTube client to retrieve video results for podcast queries
Parse video title, videoId, channel/author name, duration, and thumbnail
Provide curated category queries for podcast genres
userStories.notes: Completed. SwaaraPodcastFeedClient connects to YouTube InnerTube search API with curated categories.

userStories.title: Redesign Podcast Environment on Homepage
userStories.description: As a user, I want a clean, dedicated podcast feed on the homepage when selecting the Podcasts tab without global music search clutter.
acceptanceCriteria: Redesign SwaaraPodcastEnvironment.kt to display real YouTube podcast episodes
Interactive category chip filter updates feed seamlessly
Tapping an episode starts instant audio playback
No global music search routing triggered from podcast cards
userStories.notes: Completed. SwaaraPodcastEnvironment updated with category chips, duration badges, and direct audio playback.

userStories.title: Audio-Only Default Playback with Interactive Video Mode Toggle
userStories.description: As a user, I want podcasts to play audio-only by default, but have a View Video button to watch the episode when desired.
acceptanceCriteria: Default to audio-only playback when a podcast item is tapped
Add an Audio Mode / Video Mode toggle switch in Now Playing screen for podcasts
In Video Mode, display the video stream or web player surface
In Audio Mode, display the standard audio album art / animated soundwave
userStories.notes: Completed. SwaaraNowPlayingScreen updated with segmented mode switcher and embedded video player for podcasts.

userStories.title: Build & Distribution Verification
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the updated application to build cleanly offline and package into the release APK.
acceptanceCriteria: Copy fresh release APK to A1_Swaara_v1.0.apk
Commit changes cleanly in both Git repositories with author VarshuDev <varshudev@veloriolabs.internal>
userStories.notes: Completed. Offline release build assembleHttp3Release passed. Release APK copied to A1Swaara_apk.
